limitations: 8 classes, one noise seed, 100 correlated times; not population prevalence or independent replication.
FP32/no TF32 differs from BF16 production; official IG formula and grid retained, without production bitwise-parity claim.
Two fresh Hutchinson probes per step are noisy; directional VJP quadratics do not remove ell uncertainty.
Frozen-coefficient ratio quadrature and Euler state integration are approximate; no density update at the zero-time endpoint.
Late huge ell values are uncalibrated diagnostic estimates, not established true ratios.
Neural denoiser-implied score need not equal CNF-induced marginal score.
No candidate feedback, training, decoding, selection, or FID.
